title: One Region, Five Workforces: Why a Single Southeast Asia Engagement Strategy Fails
summary: Most multinationals manage Southeast Asia as one region. One engagement survey, one benchmark, one action plan, usually designed at a regional headquarters in Singapore and rolled out everywhere else.
